# Schema migrations verification

**Verdict**: FAIL
**Mutations**: 3 - probed C4 (`check` older bound), C13 (dry run on SQLite), C9 (advisory lock before the version re-read)
**Proofs**: `proofs.md` being regenerated by the builder; the Verifier reran `tests/test_migrations.py` and `tests/e2e/test_pr6_migrate.py` at 0b58be3 in a scratch copy: 19 passed
**Verifier**: independent sub-agent (author != verifier)

## Findings

| Finding | Evidence | Fix | Closed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| With `database_schema` set, `migrate()` on a schema that has no ledger upgrades the same-prefix ledger in `public` instead of raising `EmbeddingMismatch` (AC 11), and `schema_version()` reports `public`'s version for it, so `Memory` says "run `memhub migrate`" where it should say "run `memhub init`" | Verifier's own example: v0.1.0 ledger loaded in `public` with prefix `a`; `MemoryStore(dsn, a, schema="tenant_w").schema_version()` returned `1` (expected `None`); its `migrate()` returned `["0002_run_and_agent_ids"]`, after which `public` was at version 2 with `run_id` added and `tenant_w` still had no tables. Cause: `_version` uses an unqualified `to_regclass('<prefix>_memhub_meta')`, and `connect` sets `search_path TO <schema>, public`, so the lookup finds `public`'s table (`postgres.py` `_version`) | When `self.schema` is set, look up `<schema>.<prefix>_memhub_meta` by its qualified name, and qualify the migration's tables (or check that the meta table is in `current_schema()`). Add a test: a v1 ledger in `public` and an empty schema with the same prefix gives `schema_version() is None`, and `migrate()` raises `EmbeddingMismatch` and leaves `public` at version 1 | |
| No test covers dry run on SQLite or the in-memory backend. A SQLite `migrate(dry_run=True)` that applies the migration and writes version 2 passes every test | mutation `sqlite.py: if not dry_run: -> if True:` not killed by `test_cli_migrate_dry_run`. The only dry-run test runs on Postgres through the CLI | In `test_migrations.py`, check on each backend that a version-1 ledger gives `migrate(dry_run=True) == ["0002_run_and_agent_ids"]` and that `schema_version()` is still `1` afterwards (the Verifier's version of this passes at HEAD) | |
| C5 says "every call" is refused on a version-3 ledger, but the test only calls `search` | `test_a_newer_ledger_is_refused`: `m.search("x", **IDS)` is the only `Memory` method called, while C4 loops over `add`, `search`, `get_all` and `queue`. The Verifier's loop over all four on the in-memory backend passes at HEAD | Loop `add`, `search`, `get_all` and `queue` in `test_a_newer_ledger_is_refused`, as C4 does | |
| AC 14 says the reason goes to stderr, but C14 asserts on the combined output. For the case with no ledger, it only checks that the text contains `init` | `test_cli_migrate_failures`: `none.exit_code == 1 and "init" in none.output`; `NEWER in newer.output`. Neither looks at `result.stderr` | Assert on `result.stderr`, using the full `EmbeddingMismatch` message for no ledger and the full `NEWER` message for a newer ledger, and check that stdout is empty | |
